# Atmospherics Atmospherics is the Engineering subdepartment responsible for maintaining the station's atmosphere and ensuring that it remains safe and breathable for the crew.
Atmospheric Technicians handle Atmospherics under the supervision of the Chief Engineer.
[color=#999999][italic][italic][/color]
## Responsibilities You will usually need to respond to [textlink="atmospheric incidents" link="AtmosphericUpsets"] across the station. These can range from minor leaks to full-blown [textlink="fires" link="Fires"] or [textlink="depressurization" link="Spacing"].
Staff from other departments may also request [textlink="gas canisters" link="GasCanisters"] for their work, such as [textlink="plasma" link="Gasses"] for [textlink="Science" link="Science"] or [textlink="carbon dioxide" link="Gasses"] for [textlink="Chemistry" link="Chemist"].
In your spare time, you can improve the station by setting up rooms with special atmospheres for [textlink="Vox" link="Vox"] and other species, or by producing [textlink="exotic gases" link="Gasses"] for the station's needs.
When there is no Atmospherics work to do, you may be expected to help regular Station Engineers and train new engineers and Atmospheric Technicians.
